title: Legislative Parties of the Americas Since 1925
text: partiesAL package provides two interconnected datasets legislative parties political coalitions across 21 countries Americas, including 20 Latin American countries United States. current version covers period 1925 2024, ongoing updates incorporate new legislative periods. first dataset, parties, contains annual information political parties legislative representation, party (party faction) unit analysis. includes data legislative seats, party affiliations, presidential parties, governing coalitions. second dataset, parties2, aggregates information country-year level provides additional indicators party system characteristics, including effective number parties legislative strength presidents governing coalitions chambers congress. Users can access data installing partiesAL R package using instructions . Alternatively, datasets available direct download CSV, XLSX, Stata (DTA) formats, allowing use across different statistical software environments. Detailed definitions coding procedures variables provided accompanying codebook, available link .

code: library(partiesAL)  nparty <-      partiesAL::parties %>%      select(ccode, pty_code, year, legis) %>%      filter(legis %in% c(1,3)) %>%      distinct() %>%     select(-pty_code, - legis) %>%      split(., .$ccode) %>%      lapply(., table) %>%      lapply(., as.data.frame) %>%      do.call('rbind', .)    ggplot(nparty, aes(x = as.numeric(as.character(year)), y = Freq))+     geom_bar(stat="identity", width = NULL, fill = "#279F00", color = "black") +      facet_wrap(~ccode, ncol = 3) +      theme_minimal() +     labs(x = "", y = "") #> Warning in geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = NULL, fill = "#279F00", color = #> "black"): Ignoring empty aesthetic: `width`.

Uni?n C?vica Radical UCR) founded Argentina (cowcode = 160) 1890. Thus, code party 160189001. fac_name Name faction.  Factions may lack formal name; case, added brief note identify faction (e.g., "Dissident Liberals"). row represents whole party (norm) variable left blank. fac_code Twelve-digit faction code: first nine digits equal party code (pty_code); last three digits arbitrary sequence identify specific faction within party (e.g., 001). s_low Number seats obtained party (faction) Lower () House. legislature, party seats lower House, variable left blank. ts_low Total number seats Lower () House (including vacant seats). legislature, left blank. s_upp Number seats obtained party (faction) Upper House. Note: Senate, party seats Senate, left blank. ts_upp Total number seats Upper House (including vacant seats). Note: legislature, left blank. presp Coded 1 line corresponds president's party; 0 otherwise. cl_other Coded 1 party belongs president's coalition; 0 otherwise.
